subject: HTML template: how to update variable values in ui.R

messages.author: 46b63db5e5ff7d37
messages.subject: HTML template: how to update variable values in ui.R
parts:
Hi all,
I want to update the html content dynamically based on the input file.
For example, in the example below, I want to update `name`, `age` and `from` information  based on the file I upload. (source code)

runGitHub("templateTest", "mingsnu")

I think maybe the simple example above can be handled by using `sendCustomMessage`. 
However in my real application the file uploaded is stored as a more complicated `list` object and I think using `sendCustomMessage`
could be very complicated.
I'm wondering whether there is a better way of handling this problem.
Any suggestion would be greatly appreciated!
Thanks!

Best,
Weicheng
